industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Guangdong Electric Power Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China's Guangdong province, Guangdong Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the investment, development, operation, and management of various power generation facilities. The company produces and supplies electricity utilizing a diverse portfolio of energy sources, including thermal, liquefied natural gas (LNG), wind, biomass, solar (photovoltaic), and hydropower. By the end of 2021, specifically December 31, its total installed capacity had reached 29.9426 million kilowatts. Established in 1992, the firm is headquartered in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, and functions as a subsidiary of Guangdong Energy Group Co., Ltd.
